feeds.title: The Planet D Blog
feeds.description: An adventure travel blog that features travel tips, travel advice, travel inspiration and photography that will help you plan your vacation. Dave and Deb have visited over 115 countries on all 7 continents since 2007, and in that time they have become the leading source of detailed city guides, personal travel tips, inspiring stories and so much more.

feeds.title: Goats On The Road Blog
feeds.description: The Blog is by Nick and Dariece, the founders of this travel and lifestyle website 'Goats on the Road'. The blog features a lot of posts about living and traveling in exotic places around the world.

feeds.title: The Barefoot Nomad
feeds.description: 'Charles Kosman and Micki Kosman, founders of this website and adventurous Canadians who love to see the world and write about all things travel related. We've been sharing travel tips on this website for over 10 years (or a million years ago in internet years) as our journal into the world of adventure traveling.

feeds.title: Drink Tea and Travel
feeds.description: A Canadian couple inspired by the world, fueled by curiosity, a sense of adventure, and a desire to make a positive impact on the destinations and communities we visit. Drink Tea & Travel is an award-winning sustainable travel blog with a mission to inspire an alternative lifestyle and sustainable travel practices around the world.

feeds.title: Traveling Canucks
feeds.description: Travelling Canucks are Nicole and Cameron Wears, a married couple and parents who live in beautiful Vancouver, British Columbia, Canada. The goal for this travel blog is simple to share our travel stories from around the globe and in our beautiful backyard, with the hope that it will inspire you to travel more or help you plan that next big adventure you've been dreaming about.

feeds.title: Retired And Travelling
feeds.description: Linda and David are travel bloggers and photographers - semi retired and travelling everywhere around the world. Having visited over 100 countries, we are sure to have some travel inspiration and great travel tips for you! Retired and Travelling gives us opportunities for scuba diving, luxury cruising, indulging our chocoholic needs, and appeasing our sea and sunshine addictions.

feeds.title: Justin Plus Lauren Blog
feeds.description: I'm Lauren Yakiwchuk. I started this blog as a memory of my travels with my partner, Justin. Now, it's a travel guide to help you! Justin and I travel together most of the time, but sometimes I go places by myself as a solo female traveler. I love writing about outdoor adventures, exploring cities and small towns, history, culture, architecture, and street art.

feeds.title: Must Do Canada
feeds.description: Do Canada Right with complete guides, tips, stories and inspiration for travelling around Canada. We're a Canadian couple with two totally different backgrounds. Over the past 10 years, we have travelled to 42 countries spanning six continents, which has given us the expertise to plan amazing trips and find memorable experiences which we like to share through the blog.

feeds.title: Off Track Travel
feeds.description: Explore beyond the beaten path by foot, road and paddle with Jean Robert and Gemma at Off Track Travel. We are a British-Canadian couple who love to travel and discover lesser-known places. We want to share these experiences to inspire and help others to do the same.

feeds.title: Hopscotch The Globe Blog
feeds.description: Kristen and Siya are the adventure seeking, world travelling, tiny home living couple behind the Hopscotch The Globe brand. They showcase everything from travel tips and advice, destination guides, tiny house living, beauty and fashion, food adventures, bizarre travel, reviews and more!

feeds.title: Hecktic Travels Blog
feeds.description: We are Dalene and Peter Heck. We sold all of our possessions in 2009 to travel the world and enrich our lives with experiences rather than things. Follow our journey.

feeds.title: Family Can Travel
feeds.description: We are a family of four living in Alberta, Canada and we are passionate about travelling. We want to inspire new parents to keep travelling after having a baby. If this sounds like something you would like to do, then we invite you to check out the travel guides we have written for new parents.

feeds.title: The Travels of BBQboy and Spanky Blog
feeds.description: We're Frank and Lissette, the people behind The travels of BBQboy and Spanky. We are a Canadian couple who left Canada in 2014 and have been full-time travellers ever since. We've visited about 50 countries during our travels and we write about the places we visit on our blog.

feeds.title: Travel with the Smile Blog
feeds.description: We're Maya and Michal - nature lovers, adventure seekers and active travellers. Our mission is to inspire you to live more adventurously, try new things, discover off the beaten path places and provide you with the best tips for your next trip.

feeds.title: Delightful Travellers Blog
feeds.description: A Canadian couple who love to travel. Anna and Trevor make their way across the globe looking for local hot spots and amazing experiences.

feeds.title: PerfectDayToPlay Blog
feeds.description: We are an adventurous family exploring the wilderness, sharing exceptional family experiences & our life, while helping others live a joyful, healthy, eco-friendly, and sustainable lifestyle. We believe in making memories every single day.

feeds.title: For Two, Please
feeds.description: We are Cat & Kev, an adventure-loving couple from Canada who are committed to helping young couples find daring adventures, food encounters, and luxury escapes unique to a destination. Follow along to learn how to eat like a local, travel like a pro!

feeds.title: VancityWild
feeds.description: We are Brie + Reuben + Oliver, and together we make up VancityWild.We are a family of west coast adventurers; followers of trails, climbers of mountains, wilderness wanderers, and true lovers of life. Sharing our experiences with others became a priority, and we used the wilderness as our inspiration. Thus, VancityWild was born.

feeds.title: Loving Life on the Go
feeds.description: We are Rick and Deb, two Canadian retired travellers. We added this travel blog to the mix so we could share our adventures, cultural experiences and tips. We also document our attempt to travel full-time on a budget.
